scope: chunk_id address/key only; chunkEvidenceRevision is separate and not reopened
format: doc:<source_id>:<first 16 hex of page content sha256>:<ordinal>

findings.text: chunk_id excludes page URL and product version. Two pages of the same source_id with identical normalized text (e.g. an unchanged page across two product versions, or a duplicate URL alias) get identical chunk_ids and the second admission violates UNIQUE(chunk_id). Not triggered by the current 30 pages.
16 hex = 64 bits of the page digest; birthday risk is negligible at corpus scale (~1e-15 at 1e2 pages, still ~1e-8 at 1e6 pages).

chunk_id depends on the page content digest, so any text change (including the fence-fidelity fix) renames every chunk_id of that page; identity continuity across recapture is carried by page/chunk evidence revisions, not chunk_id.

recommendation: Do not change chunk_id in this audit. If multi-version admission of identical text is expected, open a separate contract change adding the page evidenceRevision (or productVersion+url digest) to the chunk_id derivation, with a migration/replay proof. Otherwise keep as is; version collisions fail closed (unique violation), never silently overwrite.
